name: 客服平均响应时间/解决率统计

map.📖 查看「客服平均响应时间/解决率统计使用指南」: 📖 View the "Support Response Time Statistics Guide"
map.客服平均响应时间/解决率统计是做什么的？: What does Support Response Time Statistics do?
map.如何使用客服平均响应时间/解决率统计？: How do I use Support Response Time Statistics?
map.客服平均响应时间/解决率统计适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Support Response Time Statistics best for?
map.把客服首响（或平均响应）时长逐条录入，计算平均响应时间、中位数与达标率，并给出最: Enter each first-response (or average-response) time to compute the mean, median and compliance rate, along with the longest/shortest response, for reviewing SLA attainment; data is processed only in the browser and never uploaded.
map.平均响应 = Σ 单次时长 / 次数 · 达标率 = (≤ 阈值次数 / 总次数: Mean response = Σ single duration / count　·　compliance rate = (count within threshold / total count) x 100%
map.单次响应时长（秒，逗号或换行分隔）: Single response duration (seconds, comma- or newline-separated)
map.把一天内所有工单的首次响应时长（分钟）贴入，用均值与: Paste the first-response time (minutes) of all tickets in a day and use the mean and
map.判断整体响应水平。: to judge the overall response level.
map.对比两个班组或两个月份的响应时长分布，用极差与: Compare the response-time distributions of two teams or months and use the range and
map.抽检已解决工单的处理耗时，估算解决率与平均处理时长的匹配关系。: Sample the handling time of resolved tickets to estimate how the resolution rate matches the average handling time.
map.均值被少数超长工单拉高: The mean pulled up by a few very long tickets
map.20 个工单响应时长均值 26 分钟、中位数 9 分钟、最大值 210 分钟；中: For 20 tickets the mean response is 26 minutes, the median 9 minutes and the maximum 210 minutes; the median better represents the typical experience, and those very long tickets should be investigated separately (e.g. no staff on duty at night).
map.改版前标准差 34、改版后 12，均值均由 20 降到 15；波动收窄说明流程改: The standard deviation fell from 34 before the change to 12 after, and the mean from 20 to 15; narrower variation shows the process change really worked rather than merely coinciding with easy tickets.
map.响应时长和解决率能一起算吗？: Can response time and resolution rate be computed together?
map.页面只做数值统计、不区分指标类型；建议分两批输入（一批响应时长、一批是否解决的: The page only runs numeric statistics and does not distinguish metric types; enter two batches (one of response times, one of 1/0 resolved flags) and take the means separately, where the latter mean is the resolution rate.
map.单位需要统一吗？: Do the units need to be unified?
map.必须统一。混贴秒与分钟会让均值和标准差完全失真，建议先换算成同一单位（推荐分钟）: Yes, they must. Mixing seconds and minutes completely distorts the mean and standard deviation, so convert to one unit first (minutes recommended) before pasting.
map.样本太少结果可信吗？: Is the result reliable with too few samples?
map.十几条样本的标准差本身波动很大，建议至少积累一个完整周期（如一周）的数据再下结论: With only a dozen samples the standard deviation fluctuates a lot; accumulate at least one full cycle (e.g. a week) before drawing conclusions, and keep the raw data for later verification.
map.汇总首响与解决时长，输出均值/中位数/P90: Summarise first-response and resolution times with mean / median / P90
map.纯前端处理，数据不出本地: Fully client-side; data never leaves your device
map.团队与个人绩效短板定位: Pinpointing team and individual performance gaps
